subject: English
passage: Like other desert animals, the fennec fox (Vulpes zerda) is unable to regulate its body temperature through sweating, so during periods of extreme heat, it ______ by staying in underground burrows during the day and becoming active only at night when temperatures drop.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice D is the best answer. The convention being tested is the use of verbs to express tense. In this choice, the present tense verb "survives" correctly indicates that the fennec fox regularly survives extreme heat by staying in underground burrows and being active at night.
